budget: One primary configuration per hypothesis and scheme. Fixed diagnostic controls only. Fit and choose H17 weights on earlier data inside each outer training set. No selection on the outer scores.
evaluation: Compare exact archived keys, labels, predictions and split membership. Report pooled Pearson squared for archive comparisons, plus all section-by-campaign scores with an explicit undefined reason. Rank primary variants only.

H16.description: Predict the next measured minimum minus the historical proxy using prior thickness and within-segment disagreement. Fit Huber and matched squared-loss Ridge with equal section weights. Center correction on all directly measured segments in each full prediction grid, then add it to joint_blend. Both signs of change are allowed.

H17.description: Apply an unmodified S1C auxiliary with one correction weight for high-support prior segments and one for low-support prior segments. Fit S1C without the outer section. Pick weights on inner leave-one-section-out predictions on the historical proxy. High-support weight cannot exceed low-support weight. Maximize the mean of the defined per-section r-squared scores only when all sections have a defined score. Prefer smaller sums of weights on ties. No correction without direct measurement. Use own and nearby eligible point coverage as a proxy for reliability.

H18.description: Add prior point summaries to the original S1C Ridge and apply only the difference of the extended and original corrections to joint_blend. Summarize positive lengths and widths in mm at the reported point, with no geometric overlap or cross-campaign matching. Type summaries use prior description of metal loss or corrosion and prior external designation. Train-only preprocessing can drop unsupported type fields.

H19.description: Extend the frozen spatial Ridge with height relative to the local length-weighted mean, local elevation slope, and its derivative. Build each physical window on the full grid of one section. Use identical physics, regularization, centering and clipping.

H20.description: Extend the frozen spatial Ridge with estimated segment temperature (mean of scenario inlet and outlet) minus the full-section length-weighted mean. Use the existing heat-loss scenario from pre-cutoff hydraulic rows. Train with the frozen label set and train-only imputation. For a section without a complete valid thermal profile, use the frozen spatial prediction for the whole section. Local cooling and position/terrain controls run on the same keys and physics.
